name: Soshite, Kanojo wa Netorareru ~Musubareta Hazu no Osananajimi wa, Betsu no Otoko no Ue de Koshi o Futteita~
original_name: そして、彼女は寝取られる ～結ばれたはずの幼馴染は、別の男の上で腰を振っていた～
source:
The main characters, Shin and Mana, along with Kouta—who is one year younger—are close childhood friends.

However, without even realizing it, Shin had begun to develop feelings for Mana.
It was a chance occurrence that made Shin realize those feelings.

Though Shin was initially confused by these unfamiliar emotions, he eventually gathered his courage and confessed to Mana. 
Luckily, Mana had felt the same way about Shin for a long time. 
The two went from being childhood friends to a couple. 
Their other childhood friend smiled and congratulated them.

“I’d noticed for a while that the two of you had liked each other for a long time.”

Every day was happier than ever before.
Even though their relationship had changed, they thought the three of them would always get along well.

And then—

translation:
主人公慎与茉奈，连同小他们一岁的学弟功太，是从小玩到大的要好青梅竹马。

然而在不知不觉间，慎对茉奈萌生了超越友情的爱意，
并在一次偶然的契机下清晰意识到了自己的这份心意。

起初面对这份陌生的悸动，慎也曾困惑迷惘，但最终还是鼓起勇气向茉奈表白了心迹。
幸运的是，茉奈原来也早已暗恋慎许久。
两人顺理成章地从青梅竹马升级为恋人，
另一位青梅竹马功太也面带笑容向他们送上了祝福：

“我老早就看出来你们俩互相喜欢很久啦。”

每一天都比以往任何时候更加幸福美满。
他们原本深信，哪怕两人的关系发生了改变，他们三个人也一定会永远这样融洽要好地相处下去。

然而——
